Name: Farm Computer To do
Author: Kimigakawaii
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Farm Computer Todo List turns the vanilla Farm Computer into a live, at-a-glance HUD checklist. Instead of asking the Farm Computer questions one at a time, just interact with it to toggle a small overlay in the top-left corner that shows everything left to do on your farm today — watering, harvesting, animal care, machine collection, and more. The list updates automatically every 10 in-game minutes and resets fresh each new day, so you always know exactly what's left without walking the whole farm.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure the folder structure looks like
[code]Mods/FarmComputerTodo/FarmComputerTodo.dll[/code](not nested one level deeper).[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Place or use your existing Farm Computer, then interact with it to toggle the todo list overlay.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]One-tap toggle[/b] — interact with the Farm Computer to show/hide the overlay, no menus to click through.[/*]
[*][b]Grouped checklist[/b] — tasks are organized into Crops, Animals, Pets, Machines, and Others; empty categories are hidden automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-refresh[/b] — the list re-scans every 10 in-game minutes and fully resets each morning.[/*]
[*][b]Clean when done[/b] — finished tasks disappear immediately, and the HUD shrinks to a compact "All caught up!" message when there's nothing left.[/*]
[*][b]Tracks[/b]: watering and harvesting crops, feeding and petting animals, milking cows/goats, shearing sheep, collecting animal products, petting your dog/cat, collecting from machines/bee houses/tappers/lightning rods, crab pots, fish ponds, and mushroom caves.[/*]
[/list][heading]Update 1.1.5[/heading]
This update focuses on customization and fixing several detection bugs found during testing.
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*]Per-task toggles — turn any individual task type on or off[/*]
[*]A customizable hotkey (default [b]F6[/b]) to open the todo list from anywhere, without needing to stand near a Farm Computer[/*]
[*]Optional [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support — manage the hotkey and task toggles through a proper settings menu if GMCM is installed[/*]
[*]New task: [b]Fish Pond Requesting Item[/b], for when a pond needs an item delivered to grow its population[/*]
[*]New task: [b]Cave Produce Ready[/b], covering both Mushroom Cave (Mushroom Boxes) and Bat Cave (spawned fruit)[/*]
[*]Korean and Vietnamese translations[/*]
[/list][b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Refill Crab Pots not updating correctly after baiting, or after collecting a catch[/*]
[*]Harvest Crops incorrectly counting crops outside the main Farm[/*]
[*]Feed Animals using the wrong condition — now correctly checks for hay in the coop/barn or silo[/*]
[*]Wrong scan scope when the Farm Computer is used on Ginger Island instead of the main Farm[/*]
[/list][b]Improved:[/b]
[list]
[*]The HUD box now auto-sizes to fit its text, instead of using a fixed width that could clip or leave excess space[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Thanks to the SMAPI and Stardew Valley VN/Korea modding community for the documentation and tools that make mods like this possible, and to everyone who tests and reports issues to help improve it.
